title: Recovery is the job of the one who did the work
summary: Tom Dyer, 2026-11-25: the lab manager would pull the circuit breaker about 45 minutes before an exam or essay was due; if you had not saved your work and planned your recovery, it was on you. In RexxOS terms: a task saves its own state at checkpoints (its deactivating hook, RTO2 snapshot points); a role has a fenced spare on another site; and the arbitrator itself must survive a pulled plug. dev2 does not yet: the arbitrator ledger and a plan in progress live in RAM. dev3 must write each completed step to the fabric before the next starts, so a restarted arbitrator resumes the plan where it stopped.
authority: built and tested offline (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-25)
invariants: Every task can be stopped at any moment without losing what it has already done
A plan in progress must be resumable after a pulled plug (dev3)
procedure: Test by pulling the plug: muDown in tests; on the estate, spot eviction of cats1/cats2 is the lab manager
